findings.location: AD-10 and Tier 1 evidence strategy, lines 279-285 and 343-345
findings.affected_requirement: FR-043, FR-044, SC-009, SC-010, and the passed-release acceptance boundary
findings.evidence: The corrected schema requires receipts but still permits internally contradictory passed metrics: ordinaryFailureCount may exceed ordinaryFailureBudget, and usefulCount may be zero while usefulPercent is 80 or greater. The specified semantic validator in plan.md line 283 and data-model.md line 206 only resolves command, observation, artifact, and supersession references; it does not recompute aggregate values from the bound artifacts or enforce ordinaryFailureCount less than or equal to ordinaryFailureBudget and usefulPercent equal to the corpus-derived usefulCount divided by caseCount. A schema-valid, reference-complete passed receipt can therefore violate mandatory release thresholds.
findings.correction_outcome: Make passed-receipt semantic validation explicitly recompute every derived aggregate from the bound same-candidate artifacts and reject mismatches. At minimum enforce ordinaryFailureCount <= ordinaryFailureBudget; usefulCount <= caseCount; usefulPercent equals the defined rounding of 100 * usefulCount / caseCount and is >=80; corpus result count equals caseCount; packet/result coverage matches executed cases; and every recorded aggregate equals its named receipt artifact. Add positive and adversarial semantic-validator vectors.

findings.location: passed status checks constraint, lines 88-110, and check definition, lines 207-238
findings.affected_requirement: FR-040 through FR-046 and the mandatory Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 release sequence
findings.evidence: A passed envelope requires all present checks to be passed but requires only one check and does not require any check from each tier or a closed mandatory check ID set. One Tier 1 check plus a populated releaseReceipt satisfies the schema; the plan's semantic-validator responsibilities do not require Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 coverage. This allows a formally passed release envelope that omitted the controlled PostgreSQL restart tier, the real-LLM tier, or required Tier 1 gates.
findings.correction_outcome: Define the closed mandatory release-check inventory and require a passed envelope to contain every required check exactly once, including at least all mandated Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 gates. Enforce this through schema contains/minContains or the named semantic validator, validate tier/ID consistency and same-envelope command/artifact bindings, and add negative vectors for each omitted, duplicated, mis-tiered, or non-passed required check.
